name: AnchorCore SE Class A
summary: learnd SE engages in providing energy management services. It offers building management services (BMS), which are computer-based control systems used to monitor and manage mechanical, electrical and electromechanical services in a building, such as lighting, power, heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, lifts, pumping stations, and physical access control. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Luxembourg.
